The '''Fleet Spire''' was a structure located on the artificial world of [[Iokath]]. During the [[War on Iokath]] in [[3630 BBY]] [[Lana Beniko]]'s team secured that area, using it as a military base for the [[Eternal Alliance]] forces.<ref name="Forgotten" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fleet Spire first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the "War on Iokath."<ref name="Forgotten" />
